channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about George Floyd | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about George Floyd from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on George Floyd
item.description:
Enes Kanter Freedom:

“NBA want us to talk about what's happening in in America or the protest going on, George Floyd, um you know, Black Lives Matter. So, you guys are the voice. You guys are the leaders of our community. So, go out there and talk about it.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on George Floyd, Oct 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nic Claxton on George Floyd
item.description:
Nic Claxton on George Floyd:

“We do have discussions about it, certain guys from time to time, just thinking about ways we can help and ways that we can make a change. But that’s where we are in today’s society and there’s a lot of work that needs to be done.”

Nic Claxton on George Floyd, May 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Nic Claxton on George Floyd
item.description:
Nic Claxton:

“Yeah, our condolences always go out to the families of George Floyd, but it’s just - it hurts that that’s still something that we’ve got to talk about today in 2021…”

Nic Claxton on George Floyd, May 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
